Subject: Inquiry: expansion pricing for new telehealth workloads

Hi Soojin,

Quick note — we're planning to spin up two new product teams (Clinical Summaries & Real-time Transcripts) that will run against Redwood's Hosted API. Today our combined usage across existing features averages ~200M tokens/month. The two new teams are estimated to add ~120M tokens/month (peak), with some burst to ~180M in month 1 of rollout.

Priorities for us: predictability for budgeting, a reasonable per-token rate for the incremental volume, and flexibility to scale the commit if the pilots go well. Can you share:
- Incremental commit pricing (if we add 120M tokens/month on top of our current usage)
- Any step-downs for larger commit tiers (6/12 month)
- Whether you offer temporary pilot pricing / credits for the first 30–90 days

We have a procurement window in the week of May 24th and would like to have a formal proposal before then. Ben (cc) will handle procurement specifics if/when we move forward.

Thanks,
Emma Brown
VP Product, KiteHealth
emma.brown@kitehealth.com
Office: 617-555-0142

Emma — thanks for the clear context, and congrats on the product launches. High-level answers below; I'll follow up with a formal pricing sheet and a recommended pilot structure attached.

Summary (quick):
- Current baseline: your existing usage at our standard hosted rate ($0.00040 / token) remains unchanged for existing workloads.
- Incremental commit (recommended): 120M tokens/month committed for 12 months -> proposed blended rate $0.00034 / token on incremental volume.
- Shorter commit: 6-month commit -> $0.00036 / token on incremental volume.
- Pilot: We can offer a 60-day pilot with a $5k credit against first invoice to cover initial bursts + onboarding.

Questions for sizing:
1) Are the 120M tokens/month a steady state or initial peak estimate?
2) Any retention / compliance requirements that would push you to a Private deployment (VPC) vs Hosted?

Attached: kitehealth_pricing_draft.xlsx (draft tier table + preliminary SOW) and redwood_standard_sla.pdf.

If you want, we can lock the above proposal in a short-term MPA and then amend for larger commits after month 2 if usage grows faster. I can also route a procurement-facing quote via DocuSign once you confirm numbers.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee

Agree with Soojin's framing. Guidance from revenue ops:
- Approve $5k pilot credit.
- Approve the 12-month incremental commit at $0.00034/token as an on-paper list for commercial; authorize up to 12% net concession in hand to close the deal (can be applied to the blended rate or via one-time credit).
- For customers that exceed 1B tokens / year post-commit, require a formal executive review for any additional discounts (we should route to Finance + CRO).

Also recommend we include a clause: automatic review after 60 days of pilot to convert to full commit if key KPI (latency <120ms p95, error rate <0.5%) is met. That protects us operationally.

I'll draft the concession approval note and update the pricing spreadsheet.

— Priyom
